note: Real repositories, cloned shallow, measured, and deleted again. The fixture corpus cannot see a pattern that no fixture happens to write: `destination:\s*\w` went in at 1.27.0 with 0 changes across 234 fixtures and inferred three B2B products as marketplaces, because no fixture writes a Next.js redirect. These are the counterweight. Sources are deleted after each run. Language coverage matters as much as product coverage: the detectors carry rules for Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby and .NET that no JavaScript or Python repository can exercise, and every one of those rules was written for a real repository that is named in the comment beside it. Those repositories are here so the rule stays measured.

repos.is: no-code database; inferred ai-saas, which is correct rather than a defect: it ships an OpenAI-backed feature, and ai-saas refines b2b-saas by adding a cost ceiling and prompt safety. A product with an inference bill has one whatever its main job is.
a model chat interface; the set had no product whose main job is inference
Go notification server; the Go logging and health rules were written for it, and it is what moved `accounts to manage` from -1 to -3
Rust password server; the Rust rate-limiting rule was written for it
PHP/Laravel personal CRM; the Laravel throttle alias and the per-request runtime rule were written for it
Ruby on Rails link aggregator; the rack-attack rule was written for it
Django infrastructure database; a second Django shape beside plane
.NET; the NLog/CLEF logging rule was written for it, and nothing else here is C#
Elixir/Phoenix; the bcrypt_elixir, guardian and mix-deps rules were written for it
Kotlin/Android; the mobile profile and the permission-contract rules have nothing else to run against
Rails customer-support SaaS; Active Storage attachments, which no other repository here receives through Rails
NestJS and SvelteKit photo server with a Flutter app; Material Design icons in a Svelte UI, and no second factor
Laravel multi-company accounting; its tenant is a company, joined to users by user_companies, and nothing else here is a Laravel B2B product
